from paraview.simple import *
from paraview import servermanager
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['/workspace/fracture.vti'])
s=TTKTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence(Input=r)
s.InputArray=['POINTS','Scalars_']
s.PersistenceThreshold=0.05
s.ThresholdIsAbsolute=1
m=TTKMorseSmaleComplex(Input=s)
m.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_']
m.MorseSmaleComplexSegmentation=1
m.CriticalPoints=1
m.UpdatePipeline()
for n,x in [('s',s),('cp',m.CriticalPoints),('seg',m.MorseSmaleComplexSegmentation)]:
 d=servermanager.Fetch(x)
 print(n,d.GetClassName(),d.GetNumberOfPoints(),d.GetNumberOfCells())
 print('arrays', [d.GetPointData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())], [d.GetCellData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetCellData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
 for i in range(d.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays()):
  a=d.GetPointData().GetArray(i); print(a.GetName(), a.GetRange())
PY
/opt/conda/bin/pvpython /tmp/a.py"
